candidates.place_reason: 306d audit 2026-10-13: the 8 anchors form a trapezoid (0.581 m/px along the u=100/400/50/850 side but 0.70 along the u=800 column - no similarity can hit both; the fit is 0.581 m/px, rot 0.66, resid 20.5-74.6 m, plate centre ~42/-34 m ESE of the site point), and the drawn Mackenzie 1897 plan (numbered rooms 1-38, the great courtyard, the GREAT DOOR; ~800x860 px = 465x500 m at the fitted scale) is ~10x too big: the real castle (a ~50x40 m stone house at the site point - the green-roofed house with the pond SE and formal gardens N in the aerial) sits at the drawn plan's WEST edge (the OS 'Herstmonceux Castle (Remains of)' label lands on drawn rooms 10/16/22), and the drawn great courtyard (151x134 m) and all the eastern rooms spread over the pond, wood and fields EAST of the real building. Document deleted.
